whatThisFileIs: An R1 authorship claim for the AFC-271 duplicate-ADR-number fix. The CTO authors this change; it touches the R2 compliance path (.github/workflows/ci.yml and the retention engine SQL), so it cannot land without independent review. The R2 review is assigned to the SecurityEngineer seat on AFC-349 (Rule 2: engine-path commits are reviewed outside the authoring chain). This claim carries no reviews[] entry yet; the verdict will be recorded here when it lands, and the landing commit will carry Issue: and Reviewed-by: trailers.
whatTheChangeDoes: Resolves the duplicate ADR-0006 on main. The retention-schema ADR (AFC-208 decision) is renumbered to ADR-0007, the next free number: file renamed, H1 updated, body otherwise byte-identical (no other 0006 string in the body). The register-seal ADR keeps ADR-0006. The engine revocation comment at 0001_retention_engine.sql:893 changes one comment line from the bare 'ADR-0006' to the full filename 'ADR-0007-the-application-role-holds-no-execute-in-the-retention-schema.md'. No executable SQL is touched. A new scripts/adr-uniqueness-gate.sh fails when two docs/adr/ files claim one number; it is wired into the CI workflow as its own step plus self-test line, and into package.json gate:self-test and test. Only the adr-uniqueness hunks of package.json and ci.yml are staged; adjacent role-credential lines in the shared worktree belong to another workstream and are excluded.
verificationRecorded: bash scripts/adr-uniqueness-gate.sh exits 0 on the fixed tree (it correctly exited 1 while the old duplicate was still present). --self-test passes (reject-dirty, accept-clean, accept-empty). grep -rn 'ADR-0006' docs/ services/ tests/ returns only the register-seal ADR's own title line; no ambiguous bare reference remains.

r2Review.note: Verdict landed on AFC-349: ship, no findings, no changes requested. Reviewed the staged diff only (ADR rename, one engine comment line, new gate, CI/package wiring); confirmed no executable semantics changed and no cross-workstream contamination. The queryable reviews[] entry naming the landed sha follows in a record-review commit per the AFC-167/AFC-193 convention.
